create_time_range_series: create a time range series from a start time with a timedelta interval and return eager results
create_time_range_expr: create a time range expression with start and end bounds, interval string, and closed interval parameter
create_time_ranges_column: create a column of time range lists from dataframe columns as start and end bounds
create_time_range_with_closed: create a time range with left-closed interval bounds and custom hourly interval
create_time_ranges_with_defaults: create time range lists using default start and end time bounds with specified interval
